subject: POC trial RACI & stakeholder mapping - ClearLake Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Barnes <emma.barnes@clearlakehealth.org>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + next steps from today's demo / POC planning

Thanks again for taking the time today, Emma — great conversation. Per our call, I wanted to recap the proposed POC scope, success criteria, owners we're expecting to align on, and suggested timelines so we can lock the mutual action plan.

POC objective
- Validate Redwood inference integration for ClearLake's clinical search use case (500k records, 1–2s per query SLA).

Proposed success criteria (high level)
- Functional: search results relevant > 85% on the Q&A eval set we'll share.
- Performance: median latency <= 1.5s at test throughput (simulating 50 req/s).
- Reliability: no more than 1% error rate during the 2-week trial.
- Security/compliance: integration completes without requiring data to leave ClearLake's VPC (use private deployment or secure routing).

Evaluation plan
- Week 0: access + infra setup (shared drive with dataset + Golden set).
- Week 1: integration + dry runs.
- Week 2: stress test, quality eval, final review and go/no-go.

Suggested owners (please confirm):
- Infra (network, VPC, deployment): ClearLake infra team — please confirm person.
- App integration (instrumenting calls, feature flags): ClearLake app team.
- Security/compliance: ClearLake InfoSec (SOC2/SSO checklist).
- Procurement/contract: ClearLake procurement for PO/terms.
- Redwood delivery: Marissa (POC owner), Aditya (solutions architecture), Dev Patel (infrastructure onboarding).

Attachments: I attached a draft RACI matrix and the suggested success criteria workbook for you to review (raci_matrix_v1.xlsx, clearlake_poc_success_criteria.xlsx).

Ask / next steps
1) Can you confirm the ClearLake owners for Infra, App, Security, and Procurement by EOD Thu (Oct 2)?
2) If approved, we'll kick off on Monday Oct 5 — Dev will schedule the infra onboarding call.

Thanks — I can join a short sync with your infra/security folks if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
